mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT T1.*, nvl(nvl(TPD1.trade_id, TPD2.trade_id),TPD3.trade_id) trade_id FROM ( SELECT tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID TOTLE_TRADE_ID1, tpd.BUSI_TYPE, tpd.FINPROD_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.VDATE, tpd.MDATE, tpd.SETTLE_DATE, tpd.CCY, max(nvl(tpd.SHARE_AMT,0)) SHARE_AMT, sum(nvl(tpd.PRIN_AMT,0)) PRIN_AMT, sum(nvl(tpd.INT_AMT,0)) INT_AMT, sum(nvl(tpd.FPRICE_AMT,0)) FPRICE_AMT, sum(nvl(tpd.TRADE_AMT,0)) TRADE_AMT,
case when instr(listagg(tpd.PS, ',') within group ( order by tpd.PS),'T23')>0 then 'T08' when instr(listagg(tpd.PS, ',') within group ( order by tpd.PS),'T22')>0 then 'T09' else listagg(tpd.PS, ',') within group ( order by tpd.PS) end PS, tpd.YIELD, tpd.INV_AIM, tpd.TRADE_STATUS, tpd.IS_CANCEL, tpd.IS_CLEAN, concat(tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID,pt.PORTFOLIO_ID) TOTLE_TRADE_ID, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.CHL_ID, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.IS_OUT_TRADE, tpd.TRADE_MARKET, tpd.TRADE_PLAT, tpd.TRADE_MARKET_MODE, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, tpd.F_TRADE_ID, tpd.REMARK, pt.PORTFOLIO_ID FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd left join PTL_TRADE pt on tpd.TRADE_ID = pt.BUSI_NO left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = pt.PORTFOLIO_ID where tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{bizCode} and tpd.IS_CANCEL ='N'
and pp.PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
group by tpd.BUSI_TYPE, tpd.FINPROD_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.VDATE, tpd.MDATE, tpd.SETTLE_DATE, tpd.CCY, tpd.YIELD, tpd.INV_AIM, tpd.TRADE_STATUS, tpd.IS_CANCEL, tpd.IS_CLEAN, tpd.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, tpd.B_TRADE_ID, tpd.CHL_ID, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.IS_OUT_TRADE, tpd.TRADE_MARKET, tpd.TRADE_PLAT, tpd.TRADE_MARKET_MODE, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, tpd.F_TRADE_ID, tpd.REMARK, pt.PORTFOLIO_ID ) t1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD1 ON TPD1.PS = 'T23' AND tpd1.IS_CANCEL ='N' AND t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID1 = TPD1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON TPD1.TRADE_ID=PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID=PP.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD2 ON TPD2.PS = 'T22' AND tpd2.IS_CANCEL ='N' AND t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID1 = TPD2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT1 ON TPD2.TRADE_ID=PT1.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP1 ON PT1.PORTFOLIO_ID=PP1.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL TPD3 ON TPD3.PS = 'T38' AND TPD3.IS_CANCEL ='N' AND t1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID1 = TPD3.TOTLE_TRADE_ID AND TPD3.TRADE_STATUS = '01' where nvl(PP1.INVEST_YESORNO,'Y')='Y' and nvl(PP.INVEST_YESORNO,'Y') ='Y'

select nvl(c.INSTITUTION_CODE, d.INSTITUTION_CODE) from sys_user a left join SYS_DEPARTMENT b on a.DEPT_CODE = b.DEPT_CODE left join SYS_INSTITUTION c on b.INSTITUTION_CODE = c.INSTITUTION_CODE and c.INSTITUTION_TYPE != #{DEPTTYPE_01}/*查分行机构代码*/ left join SYS_INSTITUTION d on a.DEPT_CODE = d.INSTITUTION_CODE and c.INSTITUTION_TYPE != #{DEPTTYPE_01}/*查分行机构代码*/ where a.USER_NAME = #{userName}

select.if: SELECT DISTINCT T3.RANGE_YIELD * 100 yield FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T2 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T4 ON T4.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID WHERE T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{busiCode} AND T4.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{C02} AND t3.vdate = TO_DATE(#{vDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND t3.mdate =TO_DATE(#{mDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

if.if:
select yield from(SELECT T4.RANGE_YIELD * 100 yield,t4.vdate FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{F18} AND T1.CDATE = T2.MDATE INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T4 ON T4.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T3.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{C02} AND T4.vdate <= TO_DATE(#{vDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
order by T4.vdate desc)where ROWNUM = 1

SELECT DISTINCT T4.RANGE_YIELD * 100 yield FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION T1 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T2.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{F18} AND T1.CDATE = T2.MDATE INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T3 ON T3.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PLAN T4 ON T4.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID WHERE T1.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND T3.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{C02} AND T4.vdate = TO_DATE(#{vDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND T4.mdate =TO_DATE(#{mDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')

mapper.select: select nvl(sum(TRADE_AMT),0)amount from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 left join PTL_TRADE PL on T1.TRADE_ID=PL.BUSI_NO where TOTLE_TRADE_ID in (select TOTLE_TRADE_ID from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID =#{busiCode}) and T1.FINPROD_ID=#{finprodId} and PL.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId} and T1.PS in ('T25','T26') and T1.IS_CANCEL='N'

select BRANCH from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T1 left join PTL_TRADE PL on T1.TRADE_ID=PL.BUSI_NO where TOTLE_TRADE_ID in (select TOTLE_TRADE_ID from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL where P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID =#{busiCode}) and PL.PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioId} and T1.PS in ('T25','T26') and rownum=1
select TRADE_ID from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL where TOTLE_TRADE_ID in (SELECT TOTLE_TRADE_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL WHERE P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{totleTradeId} ) and PS = 'T23' and TRADE_STATUS = '01'

SELECT DISTINCT case when T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} then T1.P_TRADE_ID ELSE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID END id, case when T1.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS03} then T1.P_TRADE_ID ELSE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID END text
,T1.PORTFOLIO_ID
FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01} AND T1.P_TOTLE_TRADE_ID IS NULL
and (instr(TOTLE_TRADE_ID, #{search}) > 0)
UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT /* 业务编号 */ T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID id, T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID text, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID PORTFOLIO_ID FROM WFL_TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1
T1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TGF01}
and (instr(TOTLE_TRADE_ID, #{search}) > 0)

select count(1) from fin_cash_plan plan left join fin_product fp on plan.finprod_id=fp.finprod_id inner join ( select distinct p.finprod_id from fin_cash_plan p where p.is_pay_int='N' )payplan on plan.finprod_id=payplan.finprod_id where fp.finprod_market_id =#{finprodId} and plan.cash_type in ('01','04') and plan.pay_date=to_date(#{settleDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

select count(1) from fin_cash_plan plan left join fin_product fp on plan.finprod_id=fp.finprod_id inner join ( select distinct p.finprod_id from fin_cash_plan p where p.is_pay_int='N' )payplan on plan.finprod_id=payplan.finprod_id where fp.finprod_market_id =#{finprodId}
